dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A little bit right, but also a bit wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: Oh, so like, my overall direction is right, but my methods are wrong? Kind of like that outlander guy by the small cliff over there?

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: His problem is actually quite simple... He's just being too careful!

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: Roca is always worried that he might get hurt, but you can't improve without picking up a scratch or two.

dialogues.speaker: Mayta
dialogues.text: If you ask me, I should go teach him instead. I'm so fast at climbing, I'm sure I'll be a good instructor as well. I'm sure he'll get the hang of it after falling a few times!
